summary: Self-recursive count of nodes produced by a halving decomposition. For a1 < 3 the function returns 1 when a1 is positive and 0 otherwise; for a1 >= 3 it returns 1 plus the counts of the two halves (a1 / 2 and a1 - a1 / 2). The result is a node/partition count rather than a value computation.

operations.description: Base-case guard on a1 < 3; below that threshold no recursion happens.
Return a1 > 0 in the base case (1 for a1 of 1 or 2, 0 for a1 <= 0).
Recursive call for the upper remainder: v2 = RecursiveNodeCount(a1 - a1 / 2).
Recursive call for the lower half: RecursiveNodeCount(a1 / 2).
Combine both recursive results plus one: v2 + RecursiveNodeCount(a1 / 2) + 1.
Return the combined sum as the node count for this size.

unresolved: The semantics of the counted nodes (e.g. nodes of a binary/halving tree or hierarchy elements) depend on the caller sub_44BC50 and are unconfirmed here.
